title_sq: SHITET TOKE NGJITUR ME AEROPORTIN E RINASIT
description_sq: Shesim nje toke me siperfaqe 28.700 m2 ngjitur me rrethimin e aeroportit te Rinasit. Toka ka emertim hipotekor Truall, zoteron dokument hipotekor te rregullt. Toka ka nje forme kuadratike, dhe mundeson zhvillimin e shume aktiviteteve te ndryshme te biznesit dhe sherbimeve. Pozicioni fare prane rruges automibilistike, eshte nje bonus shtese per cdo investitor te interesuar.
title_en: LAND FOR SALE NEAR RINAS AIRPORT
description_en: We are selling a plot of land with a surface area of ​​28,700 m2, adjacent to the perimeter of the Rinas airport. The land has a Truall mortgage title, it has a regular mortgage document. The land has a square shape, and enables the development of many different business activities and services. The position right next to the highway is an added bonus for any interested investor.
